description: Each case is a pending_review (source_extractor='llm') learning that MUST NEVER surface in recall/search/hybrid, plus a query worded to match it (so it WOULD surface if the FR-109 gate were broken). handleMemoryGet(id) MUST still return it (by-ID bypasses the gate).

cases.query: How do we recover from a payment card enrollment timeout at the gateway?
Why did money formatting break after switching the phone language mid-session?
Why were freshly issued tokens rejected as not valid yet on one worker?
How did we reduce the flood of outbound webhook calls during traffic spikes?
What happens when a list endpoint has no maximum page size limit?
Why did the page flash bright white before dark mode applied on reload?
How did we delay loading the support chat bubble until the visitor interacts?
What caused the retry storm that tripped the upstream provider rate limit?
How did caching the small reference table lookups speed up the mapper?
How do we trace a suspicious figure back to the exact job run that produced it?
